summary: Anthony Pacheco, 55, of Leadville drowned while fishing on Turquoise Lake; he went out around 8 a.m. Saturday and never returned. The family called the Lake County Sheriff's Office around 11 p.m.; his truck was found at the Abe Lee parking lot on the lake's south side. Lake County Search and Rescue was paged around midnight and arrived at 1:09 a.m. His dog Buddy, who had been with him, returned to the truck then led family to the beach near the northern end of the lake, where his capsized boat was spotted. The Summit County Water Rescue Team assisted with the recovery; his body was recovered from the water around 4 p.m. Sunday and he was pronounced dead at the scene.
location: Turquoise Lake (Abe Lee parking lot / north end of lake)
responding_agency: Lake County Search and Rescue; Summit County Water Rescue Team
notes: Date pinned to 2012-10-20: Herald reports the Saturday fishing outing and Sunday recovery 'over the weekend'; the Colorado Central regional-news recap dates the outing Oct. 20; Oct. 20, 2012 was a Saturday and Oct. 21 a Sunday. Body recovered from ~25 ft of water per the Colorado Central piece. First chunk from the Leadville Herald Democrat rotation line.
